entries.title: Numbers 25:1
segments: ¶And Israel abode in Shittim; and the people began to commit fornication with the daughters of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 25:2
segments: And they invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods; and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.

entries.title: Numbers 25:3
segments: And Israel joined himself to Baal-Peor; and the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 25:4
segments: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up to Jehovah before the sun, that the fierce anger of Jehovah may be turned away from Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 25:5
segments: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, Slay every one his men that have joined themselves to Baal-Peor.

entries.title: Numbers 25:6
segments: ¶And behold, a man of the children of Israel came and brought a Midianitish woman to his brethren, in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of the whole assembly of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the entrance of the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Numbers 25:7
segments: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, and rose up from among the assembly, and took a javelin in his hand,

entries.title: Numbers 25:8
segments: and he went after the man of Israel into the tent-chamber, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel and the woman through her belly. And the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 25:9
segments: And those that died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: Numbers 25:10
segments: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 25:11
segments: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

entries.title: Numbers 25:12
segments: Therefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace!

entries.title: Numbers 25:13
segments: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 25:14
segments: And the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, the prince of a father's house of the Simeonites.

entries.title: Numbers 25:15
segments: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was tribal head of a father's house in Midian.

entries.title: Numbers 25:17
segments: Harass the Midianites, and smite them,

entries.title: Numbers 25:18
segments: for they have harassed you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague because of the matter of Peor.
